name: Thunderhorn Totem
summary: In Bloodhoof Village, Mull Thunderhorn asks young Horde champions to help make a sacred cleansing totem. Goblin pollution is spreading through Mulgore's water wells, and natural predator claws will bind the land's primal strength into ritual wood.

sections.title: Hunting the Plains Predators
sections.body: Mull Thunderhorn needs natural claws to make a cleansing totem. The Venture Company is poisoning Mulgore's water sources through its industrial exploitation, and he works to craft a remedy. Prairie stalkers and flatland cougars roam east and west of Bloodhoof Village. Their claws carry the plains predators' natural essences, channeling their raw, uncorrupted predatory vigor directly into the totem.

sections.title: The Nature of the Hunt
sections.body: Tauren tradition distinguishes hunting for sustenance or spiritual balance from the goblins' wholesale plunder. Mull says the native predators' pure way of hunting can help purify corrupted earth. Goblin machinery fouls the springs with oil and industrial waste, while the beasts' natural strength provides the spiritual catalyst to restore the Thunderhorn Water Well.

faq.q: Why does Mull Thunderhorn need predator claws?
faq.answer: Mull uses prairie stalker and flatland cougar claws to channel the plains' pure, primal predatory spirit into a cleansing totem. He believes the spirit of natural hunters can counter artificial, industrial corruption.

faq.q: Who is corrupting the water in Mulgore?
faq.answer: Venture Company goblins operating in Mulgore pollute the land and water. Their reckless resource extraction and mining rigs send toxic sludge into the aquifers that feed the tribal wells.

faq.q: Where are the prairie stalkers and flatland cougars found?
faq.answer: Prairie stalkers and flatland cougars roam the open plains of central Mulgore, mainly across the rolling savannas east and west of Bloodhoof Village.

faq.q: What happens after crafting the Thunderhorn Totem?
faq.answer: After carving and enchanting the totem with the claws, Mull sends you to the tainted Thunderhorn Water Well to perform the cleansing ritual and drive out the poison.

faq.q: How does this relate to the previous cleansing at Winterhoof Well?
faq.answer: The tauren are working to preserve Mulgore's sacred waters. The Winterhoof Water Well was purified first, and now contamination threatens the Thunderhorn well further north.

faq.q: Why don't the tauren simply use herbal remedies instead of animal claws?
faq.answer: Tauren ritual craft draws on elemental and physical aspects of nature. The sharp purity of apex predators provides the active, contending spiritual force needed to cut through aggressive goblin industrial poisons.

angles.text: As a tauren, defending Mulgore's aquifers from foreign exploitation is a sacred tribal duty. The Earth Mother's mandate calls for life in balance rather than plunder.
As a shaman, you invoke the living spirits of the land to cleanse water corrupted by unnatural, careless enterprise.
As a hunter, you learn the plains' native stalking beasts and honor the kill as you gather their claws to preserve the ecosystem.
